blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — For the first time, Sen. Jinggoy Estrada will personally attend Wednesday afternoon’s bail hearing in his plunder case before the Sandiganbayan Fifth Division, according to his office. Previously, Estrada attended hearings on his bail plea in the case via videoconference. The case stemmed from alleged kickbacks that special prosecutors said were included in the 2025 budget, which involved P573 million. The senator’s physical presence at the hearing comes as state witness and former DPWH Undersecretary Roberto Bernardo is scheduled to testify against him.
